examples.text: Spod zielonej farby lekko prześwituje czerwona.
Przez grube zasłony słabo prześwituje słońce.
Zobacz, czy mi bluzka nie prześwituje!

glosses: To be discernible despite obstruction; to be apparent or evidenced.

examples.text: Though she makes lots of spelling and grammar mistakes in her article, her passion for the subject shines through.
He went on to say that the society was also too loose and that WOMEN were too loose! Aha! Their true anti-woman and homophobic selves were shining through!

glosses: To be visible across a barrier.

examples.text: The clouds are heavy, but the sunlight is still managing to shine through.
